Item Class: Augment
Rarity: Currency
Greater Desert Rune
--------
Stack Size: 3/10
--------
Requires: Level 31
--------
Martial Weapons: Adds 13 to 16 Fire Damage
Armour: +14% to Fire Resistance
Wands or Staves: Gain 10% of Damage as Extra Fire Damage
--------
Place into an empty Augment Socket in a Martial Weapon or Armour to apply its effect to that item. Once Socketed it cannot be retrieved without destroying it.
Shift click to unstack.
